summary: ISM Manufacturing June 2026 printed 54.0 (37-month high, 6th consecutive expansion month), triggering the bull-case scenario from the June 30 night brief and lifting SPX above 7,460 intraday for the first time in 9 sessions; 3 new ideas added (META Q2 earnings setup, TSLA delivery beat conditional, AVGO AI hardware reentry). CMCSA long stopped out at $24.81 (−13.5%) as the spinoff premium fully reversed in one session; ARKK short hit Target 1 at $70 (+6.7%) on confirmed SpaceX IPO capital drain. NFP binary tomorrow (July 2, consensus ~100K) lands before the 3-day July 4 gap — the dominant binary risk across all 20 active positions.

closed_today.note: CMCSA closed at $24.81 on June 30, below the $25.00 stop. The 25% pre-market spike on the June 29 NBCUniversal spinoff announcement fully reversed within one session — analyst upgrades (Deutsche Bank Buy $32, Rosenblatt Buy $31) were insufficient to hold the floor. Market priced the spinoff as weakness, not strength.

ARKK short hit Target 1 at $70 as SpaceX IPO capital rotation materialized on schedule. SPCX began trading June 12 and institutional rotation out of ARKK's disruptive-tech basket confirmed the thesis. ARKK at $68.56 as of July 1; 40% covered at Target 1, remainder runs to expiry July 5 toward Target 2 ($64).
